title: BMX
description:
[h1]Ride it, grind it, land it.[/h1]
Bikes, boards and skates with real physics. Lean to steer, hit the ramps, grind any rail on any map, and chain tricks into combos. No content to mount.

[quote][b]Official server:[/b]  connect gmod.naliwajka.com:27015[/quote]

[h2]Feature List[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Nine bikes.[/b] The 20" BMX, a long and fast 24" Cruiser, a quick little 16" Mini, a geared Road Bike, a Fixie (skid stops, fakies, trackstands), an upright City Bike with a basket, a long-travel Downhill bike, a Unicycle and a Penny-Farthing.
[*][b]A skateboard, a kick scooter and inline skates.[/b] Push, ollie, flip, grind and manual on the board; hop, flip and grind on the scooter; stride and grind on the skates (equip them like a weapon). [i]New, and still being tuned.[/i]
[*][b]A picture for everything.[/b] Every bike, board and park piece in the Q menu and the [b]/bike[/b] window shows what it is.
[*][b]Spawn menu.[/b] Type [b]/bike[/b] in chat to pick a ride or a park piece. Works on servers without the Q menu.
[*][b]Real handling.[/b] Lean to steer, pedal up ramps, suspension that soaks up landings, and a bike that lands flat off a ledge instead of see-sawing.
[*][b]A detailed bike.[/b] The BMX, Cruiser and Mini are full models built in code: welded frame, laced wheels, a working chain and a bell on the bars.
[*][b]Grinds on any map.[/b] Crank grinds on rails and double pegs on ledges, with sparks. No map setup needed.
[*][b]Tricks.[/b] Wheelies, manuals, stoppies, bunny hops, flips, barrel rolls, 360s, tailwhips and barspins.
[*][b]Style poses.[/b] Superman, can-can, no-hander, X-up and more, stacked on any flip.
[*][b]Combos.[/b] Chain airs, grinds and manuals into one line, then land it for a multiplier.
[*][b]Scoring.[/b] On-screen trick callouts and combo points.
[*][b]Ride together.[/b] A friend can hop on the pegs of your BMX or Cruiser, and the City Bike has a child seat.
[*][b]Bike rack and lock.[/b] A rack that welds to a car and carries two bikes, and a lock that keeps your parked bike yours.
[*][b]Park pieces.[/b] 15 ramps, rails, ledges and quarter pipes in three sizes, with a snapping build tool.
[*][b]Replays.[/b] Press J to watch your last 30 seconds from four cameras, slow it down, and save it.
[*][b]Cameras.[/b] A cinematic camera (L) and a trick cam that pulls back in the air.
[*][b]Crashes.[/b] You ragdoll off as your own player model.
[*][b]Your bike, your colour.[/b] 14 paints, or pick any colour.
[*][b]The little things.[/b] A real ring-ring bell, wind rush at speed, splashes in water, and standing or attack riding stances.
[*][b]Gamepad support[/b] and a settings menu under Options > BMX.
[/list]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[table]
[tr][td]W / S[/td][td]Pedal / brake (in the air: flip)[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]A / D[/td][td]Lean to steer (in the air: roll)[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]SPACE[/td][td]Hold and release to hop[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Right mouse[/td][td]Wheelie / manual (in the air, with A/D: spin)[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Left mouse[/td][td]Stoppie (in the air, with A/D: tailwhip)[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]R[/td][td]Bell on the ground, always (in the air or a manual: barspin)[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]ALT[/td][td]Hold with W/S/A/D/SPACE for a style pose[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]SHIFT / CTRL[/td][td]Sprint / tuck[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]] / [ or mouse wheel[/td][td]Shift gear (Road Bike)[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]E[/td][td]Get on (at the back of a friend's bike: ride the pegs)[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]K / L / J[/td][td]Paint / cinematic cam / replay[/td][/tr]
[/table]
